name: design-research-check
description: Evidence-led design research and redesign: research real references on Pinterest, Behance, Dribbble and Cosmos, show rendered proposals, implement the chosen direction, verify the render.

interface.shortDescription: Turn a generic AI-made page into a researched, rendered redesign.
interface.longDescription: Researches real design work on Pinterest, Behance, Dribbble and Cosmos, inspects the images, extracts concrete elements, renders two or three proposals from your own content, implements the one you pick and checks the result against the baseline.
defaultPrompt: This page looks AI-made. Research real references and redesign it.
Show me researched design directions for this site. Do not change anything.
